house_style: Painted storybook look, theater stage, soft painted light, for a grade 4 theater lesson. Rich gouache and colored pencil, tactile fur and cloth, warm amber light from upper left, dimensional shading, clean silhouettes. No text, letters, numbers, logos or people.

assets.name: stage-porch
assets.prompt: A theater stage seen straight on from the audience, dark burgundy velvet curtains pulled open at the edges, an intimate painted set of a small house front porch, teal plank siding, a wooden door at right center, two steps, low railing at far right, glowing brass porch lamp by the door, worn wooden stage floor. The center and left floor are open for separately composited animal actors and a bicycle. Layered set flats, dusty rose garden glimpses, carved proscenium details. Empty stage, no characters.
